name: Compressive Volume Rendering Recovery Methods
aliases: Compressive Volume Rendering (CS-Wavelet, CS-Gradient, TV, SS)
Gradient Recovery via CS (Sen and Darabi)
Image Recovery from Subset of Pixels
definition: A set of methods intended to handle higher percentages of missing pixels and produce high-quality recovery results, focusing on sparsity/compression. These include CS-Wavelet, CS-Gradient, TV minimization, and Least-Squares (SS).
